name: The Summoning

angles.text: Facing Cyclonian and taking the Whirlwind Heart is a defining proving ground for aspiring warriors, yielding a weapon infused with the raw power of the tempest.
Bath'rah Windwatcher channels ancient primal arts far removed from civilization to command wind elementals, reflecting the deep mystical traditions of troll shamans and witch doctors.

faq.answer: Cyclonian is a powerful elemental known as the wind lord. When summoned through Bath'rah Windwatcher's ritual, he manifests as a ferocious tempest that must be vanquished to obtain the essence sealed within his core.
The Whirlwind Heart is the elemental core of Cyclonian. Bath'rah Windwatcher requires it to bind the wind lord's swirling, destructive energies directly into a formidable weapon.

Bath'rah Windwatcher is a troll mystic residing in the wilderness who possesses the knowledge to summon Cyclonian. He guides warriors through the ritual and uses the fallen elemental's heart to forge mighty armaments.

The purpose of summoning Cyclonian is to confront the wind lord in combat, slay him, and harvest his elemental heart. That essence is then used to instill a weapon with the enduring fury of the whirlwind.
Once Cyclonian is defeated and his Whirlwind Heart delivered to Bath'rah, the mystic can harness the captured elemental energies to empower a weapon infused with Cyclonian's stormcraft.
faq.q: What happens after Cyclonian is defeated?

faq.answer: The ritual takes place at Bath'rah Windwatcher's camp, where the mystic gathers the necessary primal focus to draw Cyclonian forth from the elemental realm into the physical world.
faq.q: Where does the summoning take place?

sections.body: The Summoning represents the culmination of Bath'rah Windwatcher's preparations. The hermit mystic prepares an ancient ritual to call forth Cyclonian, a fearsome elemental known as the wind lord, into the mortal realm. Rather than bargaining with the tempest, the summoner aims to subdue it, charging an able champion with striking the creature down the moment it coalesces.
sections.title: Calling the Tempest

sections.body: At the center of the confrontation lies the Whirlwind Heart, the vortex of power sustaining Cyclonian's physical form. Once the wind lord is brought low and his heart wrenched free, Bath'rah harnesses the raging gale trapped within it. This volatile elemental core serves as the catalyst to imbue a weapon with the unfettered force of the storm.
sections.title: The Heart of the Storm

summary: The Summoning is a warrior trial conducted by the mystic Bath'rah Windwatcher to call forth Cyclonian, the wind lord. By invoking and slaying the tempestuous elemental, a warrior claims the Whirlwind Heart to instill a weapon with the force of the storm.
